content.value: Following figure shows data communication diagram using 802.11 MAC protocol. Suppose the device does sensing the channel and assumes the channel to be idle and wants to transmit 1500 bytes of data. Assume the transmission rate is 10 Mbps. Calculate the time required to transmit the frame and receive the ACK as function of SIFS and DIFS. Ignore the propagation delay and assume no BER. Both a control frame and a frame without data is 32 bytes.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in Script B)
